Metadata.Title: MindsEye
Metadata.Name: FPS Unlock
Metadata.Note: Targets up to 120 FPS on supported displays, otherwise up to 60 FPS. For 120 Hz, enable the HFR bit (0x40) in attribute3 of the game's sce_sys/param.json, preserving existing flags (e.g. change 4456448 to 4456512), or use ps-patch-system's SceShellCore attribute3 override. System/display settings must allow 120 Hz. Actual FPS depends on performance, typically 30-60 FPS on PS5 Pro. On the Pro you can also set the High-CPU BAPM mode bit (0x8000000) in attribute3 for up to 10% performance boost (e.g. 138674240).
Metadata.Author: Electry

Metadata.Title: MindsEye
Metadata.Name: Force PS5 Graphics Profile
Metadata.Note: Forces PS5 instead of PS5_Trinity on Pro. Mutually exclusive with Force PS5 Pro Graphics Profile (Experimental), select at most one profile patch.
Metadata.Author: Electry

Metadata.Title: MindsEye
Metadata.Name: Force PS5 Pro Graphics Profile (Experimental)
Metadata.Note: Forces PS5_Trinity as the default device profile, including on base PS5. Mutually exclusive with Force PS5 Graphics Profile, select at most one profile patch. FPS/performance may worsen.
Metadata.Author: Electry
